verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs on Dashboards, Monitors, and the API Reference (datadog-docs-12, datadog-docs-10, datadog-docs-24) indicate that dashboards and monitors can be created and managed programmatically via the API, which supports repeatable provisioning. However, the evidence pack does not explicitly document Terraform provider support, JSON export/import workflows, or dedicated dashboards-as-code tooling, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit Terraform provider documentation, JSON schema/import-export details, and community validation of infra-as-code usage.
